info.name: Google Analytics Admin accounts Events API
Google Analytics Send Events to Google Analytics

params.name: api_secret
params.description: The API Secret generated in the Google Analytics UI. Found under Admin > Data Streams > Choose your stream > Measurement Protocol > Create.

params.name: measurement_id
params.description: The Measurement ID for a web data stream. Required for web streams. Found in the Google Analytics UI under Admin > Data Streams.

params.name: firebase_app_id
params.description: The Firebase App ID for an app data stream. Required for app streams. Found in the Firebase console under Project Settings.

items.docs: Sends one or more events to Google Analytics for processing. Up to 25 events can be sent per request. Events can be backdated up to 72 hours.
